skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: Merged the intra-client citation detector: client/tools/citations/intra.mjs plus a 28-fact self-test, bridged into the suite by IntraCitationTests (+3 unit, 0 headless - check-floor.mjs cannot see a node file under client/tools/). It is a SEPARATE tool rather than a fourth mode of detect.mjs, and the deciding reason is the exit contract: detect.mjs's 'a populated list still exits 0' is pinned three times over, because a changed UPSTREAM file is not automatically a defect. An intra-client citation is checkable against a file in the same repo at the same commit, so this one must exit non-zero and can. Everything reusable is IMPORTED from detect.mjs rather than copied. WHAT IT FOUND ON ITS FIRST REAL RUN, and fixed: 64 DEAD-ANCHOR (section and D-anchors into the divergence register that commit 1bdf998e4 deleted when it cut wpf-surface-reachability.md from 1,906 lines to 95), 14 UNRESOLVABLE (into two documents deleted at 734741fb7), 13 WRONG-LINE (eight of them into task-board.md, which is rewritten every wave - those now name the ROW rather than a line, which is the root-cause fix), 72 AMBIGUOUS-BASENAME (bridge.js alone answers to FOUR real files), and 13 stale 'AdmittedRoutes is empty' prose sites. SEVEN OF THE 28 FACTS ARE MUTATIONS: each rewrites one uniquely-occurring span of intra.mjs, imports the mutant, and asserts the fixture now produces the row the refusal was suppressing - and the harness asserts the span occurs EXACTLY ONCE first, so a drifted mutation fails loudly instead of testing nothing. That is precisely the defect that blocked the sibling tool's review. The harness was then made LINE-ENDING AGNOSTIC, because its targets are multi-line literals and intra.mjs checks out CRLF on Windows and LF on Linux - a literal match found zero on one side, which the exactly-once guard correctly reported as a refusal rather than passing vacuously. It also caught rot created by the haptics merge in the same session (three symbol citations whose lines moved) and now exits 0: 675 intra-client references, 672 resolved clean, 0 rows. CcpClient.Tests 2694 to 2697, CcpClient.HeadlessTests unchanged at 155.
